title: Compute one unmasked self-attention head
description: A quick reference for the query, key, score-scaling, row-normalization, and value-mixture terms used here.

terms.definition: Attention comparing same-sequence queries and keys, scaling their dot products, then mixing values.
An attention calculation where every query may read every available key position.
A per-position feature row expressing what content that position should retrieve.
A per-position feature row compared with queries to determine matching scores.
A per-position content row combined using the normalized attention weights.
A query-key compatibility value formed from a dot product before softmax normalization.
The shared feature dimension of queries and keys that determines the score scale.
Dividing attention scores by the square root of query-key width before softmax.
Normalizing each query's scores across key positions into weights summing to one.
A normalized retrieval coefficient for one query-key pair, not confidence in correctness.
An output row formed by summing value rows multiplied by their attention weights.
